dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But I don't want to fill in the form.

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: But here, forms are how we create order. Forms are the only thing that can bring you any consolation.

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: If you are still unwilling to fill in the form, feel free to take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: The rules aren't just on paper. They're in our every move and action. You should be able to find the answers you seek if you pay close attention and observe.
